strings: The rat bite m_c suffered has healed, but r_c informs {PRONOUN/m_c/object} that permanent damage was still done and that the injured leg will never be quite the same.

m_c complains to r_c that {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} leg seems weaker now than it used to be after being savaged by a rat. r_c tells {PRONOUN/m_c/object} that it's probably a permanent consequence of the injury.

Ever since {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/were/was} bitten by that rat, m_c's injured leg has felt weaker than the rest. The wound may have healed, but it seems something deeper beneath the skin never will.
